note: How long a signed webhook took to reach a subscriber, over real deliveries only. Never derived from the poll interval: a delivery path with nothing subscribed to it has no latency, it has a budget. The three legs are apart because they fail for different reasons - exdate's own observation lag, the outbox, and the total a subscriber experiences.

legs.announceToObserve: the chain carried the announcement, to exdate writing it to the outbox
legs.observeToDeliver: the outbox row, to a subscriber accepting the signed POST

basis: real deliveries only; nothing here is derived from the poll interval
scope: the subscriber is exdate’s own receiver on the same host, so public internet transit to a third party is not included
